title: Program Execution Mission Context v1
description: The minimal immutable Mission projection carried through design-time compilation. It is exact provenance, never a second Mission definition: it answers only 'which exact Mission Revision admitted this Program', so a reader can re-fetch the Mission itself. Mission objective, acceptance criteria, authority ceiling, budgets, constraints, scope, lifecycle, owner, targets, tasks, workers, leases, provider data, and runtime state are all excluded — duplicating them here would create a second, drifting source of Mission truth that no supersession could correct. Non-circular by construction: every field is already known before the Blueprint exists, so this projection may live inside the Blueprint digest domain. The final Mission Program Binding, which names blueprint_digest, may not.

mission_id.description: Immutable Mission identity, in the canonical Mission ID form.

mission_revision.description: The exact revision admitted. Pinned; supersession never rewrites it.

mission_digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 hexadecimal over the Mission's authoritative semantics, computed by the Mission parser and never accepted as a caller claim.
